entries.dc37c64fd6fb0f77: The company's management philosophy consists of 'Harmony', 'Transformation' and 'Contribution', and its basic management policy is customer first. As basic policies for putting these into practice, it strives to pursue quality, service, cleanliness and its own value. As issues to address, it cites strengthening its core home cleaning business (building a foundation that values ties with special members, enhancing high value-added services, and strengthening the handling of products with less seasonality) and considering new businesses.
